parameters.name: ApplicationCreationType
parameters.description: The application creation type. If this parameter is left empty, applications of the user_custom type are queried by default. To query applications of all types, set this parameter to all.

parameters.name: ApplicationIdentityType
parameters.description: The application identity type. If this parameter is left empty, applications of the application type are queried by default. To query applications of all identity types, set this parameter to all.

parameters.name: ApplicationName
parameters.description: The application name. Only left fuzzy match is supported.

parameters.name: AuthorizationType
parameters.description:
The application access authorization type. Valid values:
- authorize\_required: Explicit authorization is required for access.
- default\_all: All members have access permissions by default.

parameters.name: M2MClientStatus
parameters.description: Specifies whether the M2M Client identity is enabled.

parameters.name: ManagedServiceCode
parameters.description: The ServiceCode of the cloud service that manages the application template.

parameters.name: ResourceServerStatus
parameters.description: Specifies whether the ResourceServer capability is enabled.

parameters.name: ServiceManaged
parameters.description: Specifies whether the application template is managed by a cloud service.

parameters.name: SsoType
parameters.description: The SSO type filter condition. Multiple types can be separated by commas. Example: oauth2/m2m,oidc+oauth2/m2m.

parameters.name: Status
parameters.description:
The application status. Valid values:
- enabled: Enabled.
- disabled: Disabled.
